title: Bissell Easy Sweep: A Little Much, in Many Ways
text:
Bissell Easy Sweep: A Little Much, in Many Ways. A broom and dustpan are the usual tools used for small cleanups in the kitchen or on other smooth, flat surfaces. This manual method works, but there are other options; options that get the job done without bending or stooping. One of then is the Bissell Easy Sweep Cordless Rechargeable Sweeper.

Taking this device out of the box, assembly is the first thing to complete. It is simple- you just snap the handle together, then plug it in. The sweeper can then be unplugged and used for ordinary sweeping. It can be used on flat floors or on carpet as long as the carpet is flat.

I have used this tool many times now and it is definitely a device with its share of good and bad. Looking first at the good points, this cordless sweeper works well on small jobs and picks up crumbs and other small debris without much effort. It is VERY lightweight, starts with the press of a large, flat button, and empties with the press of another button. There is no bag to empty or replace and with cordless, plug- in action, you don't need batteries.

The positive points make this device sound like a winner, but once you have used it a few times, you realize that Bissell did overlook a few important points. First, let's talk about this weight issue. It is always nice to have a sweeper that is lightweight, but the lightness in this instance is almost too much- it makes it seem low in durability and quality. The swivel action is also too much- it swivels in every direction, like it is barely held together. It seems like it is on the verge of breaking at every moment.

As for the cleaning ability, this Bissell products is only average overall. It has no problem picking up small crumbs of food, but it isn't very powerful and you often have to go back over the same area to pick everything up. Another annoyance is with the handle. Pick up the sweeper and shake it in any way, and there is a chance the handle will fall apart and have to be reattached.

So, how do I rate the Bissell Easy Sweep Cordless Rechargeable Sweeper? Well, as you can see, it has its share of good points and bad points and I can understand perfectly why some have rated it below average. I am going to go ahead and rate it at the middle, three- star level. It is not without flaws- that is certain. But it does come in handy when you need to clean up small jobs in the kitchen and as long as you keep its limited abilities in mind, it should work okay for your simpler cleaning tasks.

description: Easy Sweep Cordless Rechargeable Sweeper, 15D1A by BISSELL Sweepers Ever since Anna and Melville Bissell patented the sweeper in 1876, it’s been the standard for easy cleanup. Whether power or manual, our sweepers work on a variety of surfaces—including hard floors, area rugs, and carpet—so they’re ideal for everyday use. Throw out your broom and dustpan and bring home an easier clean. Power (Rechargeable) Sweepers BISSELL power sweepers pick up more lint, crumbs, and dirt than manual sweepers. Plus, they’re slim, lightweight, and cordless. A dirt- and crumb-free floor is easier than ever. The uses of a rechargeable sweeper vs. a vacuum The EasySweep Cordless Rechargeable Sweeper provides a convenient and easy way to pick up daily dirt and unexpected dry messes in between routine vacuuming. Since the rotating brush is battery powered, it can quickly sweep up debris large and small with little effort on your part. With a slim design, the EasySweep is perfect for leaving sitting out or in a nearby closet for quick pick-ups throughout the week. Since the EasySweep has a no-touch dirt container you can press a button on the top of the foot to release the dirt cup’s contents into the trash without having to make contact with the mess. Lightweight A big-time clean doesn’t always mean a big-time size. At BISSELL, we’ve designed several lightweight options to bring you the great cleaning you need in an easy-to-carry design. Small Living Spaces We know space can sometimes be at a minimum so we’ve designed powerful floor cleaners that are compact and easy-to-store. Plus, many of our products have narrower cleaning paths making it easier to maneuver around furniture and in small spaces.
